title: SAFRB Non-anticipative Policy Report v0.1

claim_ceiling.const: Exact finite two-site, one-resource, two-stage non-anticipative pre-positioning result for the supplied synthetic scenario tree only; no scenario-set completeness, evidence authority, probabilities, physical asset qualification, dispatch authorization or actual beneficiary-service claim.

minimum_common_preposition_units.description: Exact minimum resource count required by one common pre-observation allocation across all scenario leaves.

minimum_full_recourse_units.description: Exact minimum resource count required when each scenario may allocate after its distinguishing observation.

full_recourse_assumption.description: Full recourse is an information relaxation assuming the scenario is observed before repositioning and ignoring travel time, relocation cost and movement constraints.

resource_units_saved_by_recourse.description: Difference between the minimum common pre-positioning units and minimum full-recourse units. This is a physical-unit recourse premium, not money or monetary value of information.

description: Here-and-now feasibility requires one pre-positioning allocation shared across all indistinguishable pre-observation histories. Full-recourse feasibility is reported separately and permits scenario-specific allocation after the event is observed. Full-recourse feasibility is an idealized zero-time repositioning information bound, not a physical dispatch feasibility claim.
